D13·a7yt — 2026-10-10
chose: An interrupt or a takeover during a gate command records no verification: the group is killed, the task stays done without a check, and a resumed run gates it first
over: Recording the killed run as fail or error
because: The operator's ^C or a stop request is not a verdict on the code. A recorded failure would reopen the task and spend one of its --max-verify-attempts, while the resume rule already gates every done task that has no check.
